positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Optimized Apache Spark pipelines on AWS SageMaker, significantly improving scalability for
high-volume product forecasting systems; enabled parallelized execution by isolating file systems,
boosting team velocity and reducing runtime conflicts.
- Instrumented pipelines with run-over-run metric logging, enhancing system observability and
enabling data-driven model performance evaluation.
- Enhanced Airflow DAGs with task-level notifications to improve coordination across dependent teams.
- Integrated a credential rotation and sync pythonic tool to manage Snowflake and Databricks GIDs,
increasing reliability and reducing authentication-related pipeline failures
- Authored comprehensive architecture and process documentation on Confluence, strengthening
cross-team knowledge sharing and onboarding eﬀectiveness.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AWS SageMaker · Databricks · Airflow · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PySpark

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed ML automated QA models, significantly reducing manual QA workload and boosting productivity with an accuracy of 95%.
- Created 3D data preprocessing tools using computer vision techniques that enabled additive manufacturing processes, eliminating product waste creation.
- Experienced in fine-tuning ML models to improve model prediction metrics.
- Implemented user friendly ML tools for 3D data analysis, giving product designers rich insights on their
target audience, resulting in researched backed product launches.
- Led data acquisition projects, coordinating with legal, business, and engineering teams.
- Drove engineering progress and communicated status and risks to stakeholders, ensuring alignment during manager's absence.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
- Automated manual HR processes, cutting labor costs and boosting productivity by 40%.
- Developed cloud automation and CI/CD pipelines, modernizing HR systems.
- Designed and implemented a private cloud network for a couple of organizations.
- Built stateless and serverless apps, enhancing team productivity by 50%.
- Led team training programs, fostering collaboration and problem-solving.

positions.title: Athlete
positions.description:
- Sharing product knowledge with consumers while personalizing each consumers experience and maintaining professional and friendly customer interactions.
- Working as a team member to bring Nike’s innovation to life by using Nike’s maxims to provide premium service.
- Taking a part of Nike volunteering opportunities such as Marathon Kids and William Walker.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered a local build server solution using Jenkins pipelines to optimize Unity3D development cycles and enhancing team productivity through reduced cloud build latency.
- Developed and implemented a QA system to test and report bugs, enhancing application reliability.
- Mentored a high school intern on technical projects, fostering skill development.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
- Performed compatibility, functionality, and regression testing for applications & websites of various clients.
- Maintained confidentiality with the client’s projects.
- Reported bugs in the proper formatting on various bug tracking tools.
